_about: The apps FreeTV's Store offers on Android TV. tools/android_catalog.py turns this into catalog.json: each app's newest release on GitHub, its APK checked (package name with aapt2) and its SHA-256 pinned. Add an app here; the daily workflow does the rest. Only GitHub releases; only APKs for TVs.
